description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-ORDER: What exact Double bits (and Field type) do Sum and Avg give over FO (d = 2^53, 1, -2^53 in insertion order; primary-key, k and insertion order all differ) through nine routes (plain scan, primary-key range, index range on k, and a derived table ordered by id, id DESC, k, k DESC, d, d DESC), and each of Sum and Avg alone on the plain scan? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.

args.text: SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM FO
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM FO WHERE id >= 1
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM FO WHERE k >= 1
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY id)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY id DESC)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY k)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY k DESC)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY d)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY d DESC)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s FROM FO
SELECT Avg(d) AS a FROM FO
